AiTransparency.title: Made with love and AI
AiTransparency.intro: Every spot on SalzGuide is visited, photographed and written up by us. For a few things, artificial intelligence helps out. Here’s honestly where.
AiTransparency.toniBody: Toni is an AI chat built on Claude (Anthropic). Toni only works with our verified spots and events and tells you openly that you’re talking to an AI. The face is AI-generated too: Toni is a character, not a person. And like any AI, Toni can make mistakes, so double-check details like opening hours.
AiTransparency.textsBody: The writing happens here: we go there, take notes, write it down. AI helps with drafts and translates everything into eight languages. Nothing goes live unchecked; Anton Steiner is responsible for what’s published (see legal notice).
AiTransparency.voiceBody: The audio tours narrate our reviewed texts with an AI voice (ElevenLabs). No real person is speaking, even if it sounds like it.
AiTransparency.humanBody: Our photos are real and taken by us. A few images get AI-extended edges so they fit wide screens; those carry a small label. The flyover videos are real 3D map footage. No emotion recognition, no ad profile.
AiTransparency.lawBody: This page is our transparency under Article 50 of the EU AI Act (Regulation (EU) 2024/1689). What happens to your chat messages is covered in the privacy policy.
